_note: Bokiem na Narodowym, the grey box (docs/design/drift-narodowy.md 0b, critique-drift.md section 4). A track is its ideal line as segments from a start point and heading (yaw in degrees, 0 = towards -z, + = left, the game's rotation.y); `straight` m, `arc` [radius m, sweep degrees, +1 left / -1 right]. Zones: `zona` (the tail at the outer board) and `klip` (the nose at an inner cone), on a segment between two fractions of it, BOARD m from the line. Words: [Polish, English] (warsaw-tone).
